items.source: Return a new assertion object that uses the BindingResult with the given name as the object to test.
items.translation: 返回一个新的断言对象，该对象使用带有给定name的BindingResult作为要测试的对象。

items.source: AssertJ assertions that can be applied to a model.
items.translation: 适用于model的 AssertJ 断言。

items.source: Verify that the actual model contains the attributes with the given names, and that none of these attributes has an error.
items.translation: 验证实际模型是否包含具有给定 `names` 的属性，并且这些属性中没有任何一个存在错误。

items.source: Verify that the actual model contains the attributes with the given names, and that each of these attributes has each at least one error.
items.translation: 验证实际模型是否包含具有给定 `names` 的属性，并且每个属性至少有一个错误。

items.source: Verify that the actual model does not have any errors.
items.translation: 验证实际模型是否存在任何错误。

items.source: Verify that the actual model has at least one error.
items.translation: 验证实际模型至少有一个错误。

items.source: names - the expected names of attributes with errors
items.translation: names - 具有错误的属性的预期名称

items.source: names - the expected names of attributes without errors
items.translation: names - 无错误的属性预期名称
